title: 572. Inorder Successor in BST II

examples.explanation: Inorder visits 1, 2, 3, so the node after 1 holds 2.
3 is the largest value, hence has no successor.
The inorder order is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, so 4 follows 3.
